# trimesh_from_pyvista { #mofography.visualize.trimesh_from_pyvista }

`visualize.trimesh_from_pyvista(pv_mesh)`

`trimesh_from_pyvista(pv_mesh)` takes a PyVista mesh and returns a Trimesh mesh

## Parameters

| Name      | Type   | Description           | Default    |
|-----------|--------|-----------------------|------------|
| `pv_mesh` |        | a pyvista mesh object | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description       |
|--------|-------------------|
|        | A trimesh object. |
